subject.title: Feature Request: Session rotation/archive lifecycle event for cron job triggers

question: Should session archive/rotation automation be supported as a core cron event schedule, as a plugin `session_end` workflow with a narrow missing SDK seam, or not as a new OpenClaw core surface?
rationale: The current code has the lifecycle hook primitive but not the requested cron subscription surface, and the permanent shape affects public cron config, plugin API boundaries, archived transcript metadata, and security review.

options.title: Use plugin lifecycle plus SDK seam
options.body: Bless `session_end` as the session-boundary signal and add only the narrow external-plugin scheduling or event-dispatch capability needed to run this workflow safely.

options.title: Add core cron lifecycle schedules
options.body: Define `schedule.kind: event` for session archive/rotation in cron config and protocol, with scoped metadata, permissions, persistence, docs, and upgrade tests.

options.title: Close as plugin-owned workflow
options.body: If maintainers decide current plugin hooks already cover the use case, document that pattern and route the self-improving memory workflow to ClawHub/plugin packaging.

recommendation.title: Use plugin lifecycle plus SDK seam
recommendation.body: Bless `session_end` as the session-boundary signal and add only the narrow external-plugin scheduling or event-dispatch capability needed to run this workflow safely.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision sits at the plugin/API/core boundary where the strongest recent hook and SDK history points to vincentkoc.
